body.text: You have had {param:years} years of us, and we have had {param:years} years of you. I write to tell you that the arrangement is changing, and that you had no part in the decision.
His Majesty's obligations have grown. They did not grow because of anything you did or failed to do out there, which I say partly to spare your feelings and partly because it is true.
What it means for you is this: you will be written to by men who have not written to you before. Some of them will be the Crown's. Some of them will not.
A colony doing badly is ignored. A colony doing well is noticed, and being noticed is not the reward the word suggests.
When a man who does not serve His Majesty asks you for something, remember that what he can take from you is not gold, and that the Crown cannot give it back.

options.text: and thank you for the warning, such as it was
and note you took your time in sending it
and would ask what is left to give
and understand it exactly as it was meant

options.label: acknowledge it, and say nothing more
options.text: The colony has heard the Crown{insert:barb}. It will do what it can.

barb.hateful: , as it always does, at length

options.label: protest that the Crown should defend its own
options.text: If men outside His Majesty's service may write to His Majesty's governor and expect an answer, I should like to know what His Majesty's service is for.

options.label: ask who exactly is coming
options.text: You have told me that others will write. Name them, and I shall know a demand from an introduction.

tone.hateful: You will find them less patient than I am. Most people are.
